oneOf.description:
The answer to `Effect::Classify`: the small model's score, or the
rules pass's own when the model failed.

extraction.description: Logs written before commitments carried only the facts, as `drafts`.

oneOf.description:
The answer to `Effect::Extract`: the facts, commitments and tab
lines drafted from one message, none when the extractor failed.

The answer to `Effect::ResolveTime`, with `TimeMeaning::None` when
the resolver failed or is off.

The answer to `Effect::Outside`: whether it went, and the provider's
reference when it did.

Mail that reached the group's address. It is a guest's words: it is
relayed and remembered, never obeyed.
The connector is up and knows who the agent is on this platform.
A room and its full membership, sent on join and whenever it changes.

message.description: The message the action produced, when it produced one.

oneOf.description:
The outcome of an `Outbound` action, so the engine learns the ids of
what it sent and whether a send failed.

message.description: The message that carries the poll.

option.description: Zero-based, in the order the options were given.

oneOf.description: A vote on a native poll the agent created, or its removal.

counts.description: Vote counts per option, in order.

oneOf.description: A native poll finished on the platform's side.
History fetched on request, oldest first.

InboundEvent.description: Everything a platform can tell the engine.

Platform.description:
A chat platform a connector speaks. `Sim` is the in-memory connector
used by tests and the replay harness.

PlatformUserId.description: A user as the platform identifies them. Never a display name.

timezones.description: The platform tells us members' timezones.

external_flag.description: The platform marks external or guest accounts.

typing.description: The platform can show that the agent is writing.

reaction_set.description:
The only reactions the platform allows, when it restricts them
(Telegram); None means any emoji. The engine substitutes from this
set for the reactions it relies on.

Capabilities.description:
What a connector can do. The engine falls back where a platform lacks
something (reaction ballots where there are no polls).

parent.description: For threads, the room they hang off.

container.description: The server, workspace or group the room belongs to on the platform.

PlatformRoomId.description: A room (channel, DM, thread) as the platform identifies it.

timezone.description: IANA zone name when the platform knows it.

oneOf.description: Marked external or guest by the platform (Slack Connect, guest accounts).

PlatformRole.description:
What the platform itself says about a user in a room. Connectors report
this; the engine maps it to a `Role` through the group's profile.

PlatformMessageId.description: A message as the platform identifies it; the unit of provenance.

mentions_me.description: The agent was mentioned, by handle or by platform mention.

ActionId.description: An outbound action the engine asked a connector to perform.

TimerId.description: A durable timer on the virtual clock.

RequestId.description: A request the engine made to a model.

message.description: The reply to send, threaded under the message that asked. Null to say nothing.

actions.description: Anything to do besides the reply.

cites.description: The msg ids, from what you remember, of the facts the reply relies on.

Plan.description: The model's answer to one addressed message.

oneOf.description: A separate message in the room, not threaded under the question.
A reaction on the message that asked.

body.description:
Plain text, signed with your name for the group. The reply
address is added for you.

oneOf.description:
An email from the group's address, held before it goes so it can be
undone. Only to an address someone gave in the room.

banter.description:
Something a mate would react to: a joke that landed, big news, a
photo, a celebration. Not part of `max`; it never makes the agent
act, only lets it chime in when the dial and the budget allow.

answerable_from_context.description: The agent could answer this from the recent messages alone.

Score.description:
Each signal from the table in DESIGN.md section 7, 0 to 1. The score of
a message is the largest of them.

MessageKind.description: What kind of thing the message is, as far as the agent is concerned.

subject.description:
Who or what it is about: a display name as written, a place, an
event ("the cabin trip"), or "the group".

predicate.description:
A short lower-case relation such as "is vegetarian", "drives",
"birthday", "address", "favourite bar", "went to".

about_self.description: The speaker was talking about themselves.

durable.description: Durable facts have no end; perishable ones carry a date.

expires.description: For perishable facts: the day it stops being true, as YYYY-MM-DD.

starts.description: For a span such as "away 12 to 16": the first day, as YYYY-MM-DD.

quote.description: The words that carry it, short, for recall and for "why".

FactDraft.description: A fact as extracted, before the engine decides scope and confidence.

SubjectKind.description: What kind of thing a fact is about.

who.description:
Who promised: the speaker's name, or another name when the speaker
assigned it ("Sam will drive").

what.description: What they will do, short, in the infinitive ("bring dessert").

for_whom.description: Whom it is for, when said: a person's name or "the group".

due.description:
When it is due, as YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, resolved from the
message's date and zone; null when no time was given.

event.description: The event it belongs to, when named ("the cabin trip", "Thursday's dinner").

CommitmentDraft.description:
A promise as extracted: "I'll have the draft by Thursday", "I'll bring
dessert", "I'll book the pitch".

payer.description: Who paid: the speaker's name unless they said otherwise.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code when said or obvious, else null for the group's currency.

participants.description:
Named people it is for; empty means everyone at the linked event or
everyone in the group.

event.description: The event it belongs to, when named.

LedgerDraft.description: Money paid for the group, as extracted: "I got the wine, 38".

phrase.description: The words that carried the time, as written.

echo.description: How to say it back, such as "Thursday the 14th" or "the week of the 9th".

oneOf.description: One moment, with or without a time of day.
A range such as "next week" or "12 to 16".
A repeating schedule as an RFC 5545 RRULE.
Two readings differ by more than a day and the difference matters.
Nothing temporal in the text.

TimeMeaning.description: What a time expression turned out to mean.

reference.description: The provider's reference: a message id for mail.

OutsideResult.description: The outcome of an outside action, fed back as an input.

body.description: Plain text, quoted replies stripped where the parser could.

in_reply_to.description:
The message ids this replies to, newest first, for matching against
mail the group sent.

authenticated.description:
The receiver's DMARC check passed for the From domain, or with no
DMARC verdict a DKIM or SPF pass aligned with it. Otherwise the
sender is less trusted.

InboundMail.description: Mail that reached the group's address.

oneOf.description:
Change the kind and reset the profile to that kind's defaults. The
agent's name, leads, hosts and observe state are kept.
Replace the named leads list.
One of the starter personas by name, or "plain" for the default.
Turn expiry and retention off, or back on.

by_host.description: Set by the host's config, which skips the name question in setup.

oneOf.description: The group's home zone, an IANA name such as "Europe/Lisbon".
Which model answers and where it runs, as the group should be told.
Any change a lead can make by sentence, applied as if a lead said it.
How new proposals close; none to go back to the kind's rule.
A member's zone as an IANA name; none to forget it.
The tab's currency, an ISO 4217 code such as "AUD".

Where the binary serves the calendar feeds, without ".ics": the
group's is `<url>.ics` and a member's `<url>/<user>.ics`. Empty turns
the links off.

Command.description: A configuration change from the admin page or the host's CLI.

Kind.description: The kind of group, which sets defaults and nothing else (DESIGN.md section 4).

voice.description: One line on how it talks.

never_jokes_about.description: Subjects it never jokes about, on top of the hard rules.

bits.description: Running bits and in-jokes the group gave it, in the group's words.

Persona.description: How the agent sounds in one group. The dial lives in the profile.

budget_per_hour.description: Unprompted messages allowed in any rolling hour.

budget_per_day.description: Unprompted messages allowed per calendar day in the group's zone.

speech_threshold.description: Attention score above which the agent speaks unprompted.

hold_window_seconds.description: How long a tier-1 action waits before it leaves the group.

answer_window_seconds.description: How long a question may go unanswered before the agent raises a hand.

observe_seconds.description: How long a new group is watched before the agent speaks unprompted.

jobs.description: The scheduled jobs, once a lead has changed them; else the kind's.

unprompted_outbound.description: Whether a tier-1 action nobody asked for may leave the group.

chime_threshold.description: The banter score at which it may chime in, at dial 2 and 3.

chimes_per_day.description: Chime-ins allowed per local day; unset follows the dial.

oneOf.description: Every member is a lead.
Platform owners and admins.
Platform owners, admins and moderators.
Only the people in the leads list.

LeadsRule.description: Who is a lead without being named in the leads list (DESIGN.md section 5).

QuietHours.description:
Local hours in the group's zone when nothing unprompted is sent. The
span may wrap midnight.

WorkingHours.description:
Local hours in the group's zone when unprompted messages may be sent.
The span may wrap midnight; equal start and end means the whole day.

digest.description: When the daily digest goes out; none for no digest.

day_of.description: The one line on a day with something on the calendar.

Jobs.description: The scheduled jobs a profile turns on (DESIGN.md section 4).

ClockTime.description: A local time of day in the group's zone.

oneOf.description: Do it, with the hold.
DM a lead with a ✅ and do nothing until one comes.

UnpromptedOutbound.description:
What the agent does when it, not a lead, wants something to leave the
group (DESIGN.md section 13, "Unprompted outbound").

oneOf.description: Quiet from `start` until the current end, or 08:00 when there was none.
Turn the dial up or down by `delta`, within 0 to 3.
Reset the profile to this kind's defaults.
End observe mode and start speaking unprompted.
Watch again for `days`, or the profile's period when not given.
The digest at this local time, which also turns it on.
The digest on at its usual time, or off.
The day-of summary on or off.
A running bit the group gave the agent.
Drops every bit that mentions these words.
One of the starter personas by name, or "plain" for the default.
Turn expiry and retention off, or back on.

SettingChange.description: A change to the group's settings, as a sentence or the admin page asks.

oneOf.description: More than half of the active members chose one option.
The most votes among those who voted.
Every active member chose the same option.
No ballot; views are kept and a lead's choice closes it.
Only these people's votes count.
Those who say they are coming decide.
